decisions.reason: The source clarifies deletion of a header in the bonus section and does not alter the independently specified Q&A box removal.
The deleted bonus header is unrelated to the already specified Week 8-9 program-content section.
Deleting the bonus-section header does not change the two-panel pricing layout, panel selection, or side-space rule.
The source concerns bonus-section header content and does not change the requirement that the duplicate page omit its pricing section.
The clarification adds no new duplication artifact or timing rule; the existing instruction to duplicate after requested removals remains valid unchanged.
Although originally discussed alongside bonus-section removal, instructor-section alignment is an independent behavior unaffected by deleting the bonus header.
The bonus-header deletion does not change which primary buttons require secondary jump controls or their label.
The source does not alter placement of secondary jump controls relative to primary buttons.
Deleting text from the bonus section does not affect the wrapper or visual styling of secondary jump controls.
The bonus-section header clarification does not change the monthly marker, its typography, or its pricing-option coverage.
The source targets a named bonus-section header, not the top block's layout or media-to-text relationship.
The content deletion does not change the target Kajabi page, account, migration identity, access procedure, or transfer method.
